notes: Thirty-nine source and forty-nine target tokens each partitioned once.

Variant WLC.EZK.6.3.v001 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base; the fallback reading remains among those the English permits and the packet carries no FALLBACK EXCLUDED mark, so rule 53 does not apply and s025-s028 are ordinary source text.

הִנְנִי אֲנִי → Behold, I, even I: the suffix takes the first I and the pleonastic independent pronoun takes even I, headed on the pronoun. Marking even added under rule 30 is the competing reading, but a morpheme is present whose sole contribution is that emphasis.
The four assimilated [הַ] tokens each take a written the under rule 12; the suffixes of אֲדֹנָי are unrendered, the ASV writing the Lord rather than my Lord.
